out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PLEASE MAKE SURE EMPLOYEES USE DRINKING CONTAINERS WITH A STRAW AND LID ONLY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink to the right of the grill is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION WILL BE OCCUR IN 10 DAYS TO MAKE SURE THE TEMP OF THE WATER AT THE HAND SINK HITS A MINIMUM OF 100F. BOZZELLI'S (Inspection Date: 08/08/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: tomato sauce in hot well was temping at 118F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL FOODS BEING HOT HELD NEED TO BE AT A TEMP OF 135F OR HIGHER. THE TOMATO SAUCE HAD ONLY BEEN IN HOT WELL FOR 2 HOURS. CFM RAISED THE TEMP OF THE HOT WELL AND ADDED WATER TO MAKE SURE IT WAS TOUCHING THE BOTTOM OF THE PAN IN HOT WELL. TEMP RAISED TO 135F.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: breakfast sandwiches are served with eggs that can be cooked to order. The cook to order eggs are not indicated with a consumer advisory.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE MAKE SURE THAT THE EGGS IN THE BREAKFAST SANDWICHES ARE NOTED BY A ASTRIK AND A CONSUMER ADVISORY ON ALL MENUS, INCLUDING THE SCREENS THAT SHOW THE MENU. A FOLLOW-UP WITH OCCUR IN 10 DAYS TO MAKE SURE CONSUMER ADVISORY IS ADDED TO MENU.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: chicken wings were being thawed on the flat top cooler by just sitting out.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM THE TWO WAYS TO PROPERLY THAW FOODS. CFM MOVED THE CHICKEN WINGS INTO A FLAT TOP COOLER TO FINSIH PROPERLY THAWING.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Multiple items in facility were not being stored in their original containers and were not easily identifiable. None of the bottles were properly labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE LABEL ALL CONTAINERS THAT ARE NOT EASILY IDENTIFIABLE WITH A STICKER AND A MARKER OR MARKER DIRECTLY ON BOTTLE.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PLEASE MAKE SUR TO STORE ALL TOWLES IN SANITIZER SOLUTION WHEN NOT IN USE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) Avancto 2DR was temping at 49F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE CONTACT A SERVICE COMPANY TO CHECK IF THE UNIT IS WORKING PROPERLY OR NEEDS TO BE FIXED. THIS NEEDS TO OCCUR WITH IN 6 MONTHS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION WILL BE OCCUR IN 10 DAYS TO MAKE SURE THE TEMP OF THE WATER AT THE 3 VAT SINK HITS A MINIMUM OF 110F.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived after 1.5 hrs and send proof via e-mail.
